name: Shibafuji Misaki
source:
Third-year student and a senpai of the protagonist. Student council president and Flower Arrangement Club member.

A model student with impeccable manners, excellent grades, and a beautiful appearance. She's the perfect image of Yamato Nadeshiko.

She's reliable in public, like when handling student council duties, but in private she's laid back and can be a bit ditzy. She's great at handling tasks that are well-defined, but struggles with decision-making and things without clear answers.

She hopes to attain great breasts through breastcare so that she can act with confidence.

She has changed the person in charge of her breastcare to check if the protagonist's skills and behavior are up to standard.
